children: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf said in a parliamentary speech on the 6th that "the era of 'reciprocal response' has ended" and that any infringement on Iran's interests and security will face a faster and stronger response. He also stressed the importance of "internal unity," saying that maintaining "internal unity" and "external deterrence" are two important means for Iran to deal with enemies, and that any words or actions that weaken these two aspects do not meet the requirements of Iran's supreme leader.

title: Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf Says Any Attack on Iran Will Face Faster, Stronger Response
